review_text: This is a very nice bag but the charger did not work. Since I didn’t used it immediately after I purchased it; I was not aware of the charger not working until I traveled. By then it was too late to return it. My advice is to test the charger as soon as you receive the bag!
I am going to buy more.
Much smaller than anticipated. No way to carry books and laptop.
This product was not what I was looking for. Thought it was. It was to thin and to me cheaply made.

I bought mine for around 140 ducks on sale. The darn thing now has broken zippers after three years because the metal zippers used is fragile, and very thin (~0.5 mm). Would recommend Everki over this.. the warranty only lasts 1 year from TrailPack..
Bought the all black version backpack, it feels fairly sturdy and got it for a great price.
Everything is awesome about it, except no side pockets for water bottle.

This bag not only secures a 17" laptop but it has so many other pockets that are suitable for carrying anything else you need. When it's on your back it is comfortable to wear for extended periods of time.

I loved this pack at first. Then realized the earbud port is not functional, as the velcro patch on the opposite side of the flap prevents access. No ez link to contact seller so I unfortunately must post here... Note: replacement has same flaw as well...I have reached out to seller...want this bag to work for me!
Looks better in the photos. It looks kind of smushed and flat in person.
What a lifesaver! Traveling back-n-forth to NY has been a breeze with this backpack. Great all-around!
The bag is just what my son wanted. Great size and not to being for him to carry

I bought this for my wife in late February and as of yesterday, the whole thing was falling apart. The zippers broke and the bag was tearing by the seams near the zipper line. She had to tape it together until she got home. Don't buy this bag. It's not worth the money.
Incredible value for the money, very well made and thought out!
Bulky and big and not that much room on the inside. It’s already heavy without anything it it too.
I use this as a work bag. Works great. Sturdy, light weight and holds plenty of items!

The backpack purse is made out of high quality materials. It also looks great. The drawback, and why I gave it a 4 instead of a 5, is the backpack is not as thick as the video makes it appear. That being said, even though the space seems to fit a lot, when you zip the front pocket and the middle pocket is full and clasped, it appears to look strained and over capacity. Adding just another half inch to inch would have made all the difference.

Straps are very comfortable, it looks great and fits all my stuff. Just big enough to occasionally cram my gym gear into too. (This was a gift so her words, not mine… she hated my first gift - a utilitarian Northface backpack).
Absolutely love this backpack!! It is sleek considering the space available, comfortable, and really just perfect. I use mine daily and may buy another for travel. Thanks!
A nice bag but too heavy and overpriced.
Great size for young kid gamer to carry variety of electronics,cords,chargers etc. Like the theft deterrant lock
used for carry on travel bag.. durability is great but the large front zippered area would be better accessible with double zippered opening like the top zipper..
Flimsy. I bought this for my son for second grade. Just putting his normal sized lunchbox was too much for the zipper. Wish I could give it zerro stars.
Great idea, but you get what you pay for. They lose connection constantly and only work if you’re within so many feet of the item. Not exactly conducive for finding lost things
Garbage product. Zipper is cheap and sticks. Straps are not ergonomic and entire product is cheaply made.
It’s cute but not too roomy on the inside, I’m able to fit what I need so it’s not too bad but I don’t see myself using it to travel, could be a spennanight bag for sure though

This was almost a very nice bag. It fits fairly well under most airline seats, sticking out a few inches. There are too many zippered compartments - and one of the zippers on mine was broken. It zipped-up shut and then just popped-open. The manufacturer cannot be reached and the only option was to get a refund. I didn't want to risk getting another bag with a broken zipper so I moved up to a TrailPack under seat bag.
This bag is nice, but the zipper is flimsy and the front pocket wasn’t sewn correctly. Will not stand up by itself like some other backpacks made the same way
Nice, well constructed backpack with plenty of room. Just right for me.

The material is ok. I notice after a few days there was some wear on the zipper part. There were some loose strings comping from thw zipper area, and it only contained my laptop. It does have lots od cpmpartments though. Could work for travel.

I needed a new laptop bag and I liked the color of this one so I thought I'd give it a try. The gold zippers against the olive green look really nice. This bag has endless pockets! There is so much storage inside and out, but yet still looks sleek and not bulky. The zippers all seem to work nicely. I haven't used it in the rain so I don't know if it is weatherproof, but it seems to be. The handle on the top of the bag seems to be reinforced so I don't think that will be breaking anytime soon.
Nice bag but a little smaller than what i needed. Returned it. Purchased another bag about the same dimensions but hold more -- i guess just the way it is designed.
Looks great and looks durable. Have not tested it, but shall later this month in Fla and then Europe in April....
This is for an iPhone 4. If you have an old iphone from 2010, then it’s going to work. They need t update it to the iPhone XR type connector and not the wide pin kind.
Loved this when it came out of the box. Heavy canvas, feels sturdy, looks great. Lots of compliments on the style. The rivet snaps fell apart pretty fast and it's useless.
Nice looking product—too bad it showed up with opened packages of food inside. Check your merchandise if you are going to resell something that someone has returned.

While this is pretty sturdy, the ability to get into the bag easily is hampered by way in which the eye holes slip over the buttons, holding the bag closed. The leather eventually will rip and then there is no way to secure the flap. I should have returned it, but was already on my trip. I'll stick with zippered bags in the future

Nice addition to my desk space to easily hang my headphones instead of just throwing them on the desk or anywhere else. Keeps them out of the way yet easily accessible. The only thing I wish is that they had better cord hanging holes... the holes don't really hold anything. It's nothing to wrap up the cord and hang it with the headphones but the built in function doesn't really work at all.. A good product to have.

My son who is not a rough handler with his things, managed to break the handles in the second week of school. Will not buy this product or anything else similar to it. It was not sturdy, it did not have a lot of books or anything heavy in it.
Very durable and easy to zip, lots of places to store things.

So I bought this because someone mentioned it fits their Omen 17 laptop. It fits yes, but it is super tight. I worry about the zipper. Other then that it seems pretty sturdy. (I'll make a update in 6 months just in case) The bag is really nice looking as well, so even if I did not have a laptop I will be using it as my main bag from now on.

I would give this bag five stars but the color is very off from the photo. The khaki color which is very tan in the photo is a much darker olive green tone khaki, one of my least favorite colors. I expected it to not be perfect but this color is way off. On the bright side it's big, comfy and otherwise attractive. The ugly brand patch is easily removed with a seam ripper.

If you carry a larger laptop, this bag is great. I like it for when I travel for work. I can fit my laptop and everything else I need to carry on to the plane. If it is just an overnight trip, I can fit everything into this one bag. Keeps my laptop nice and safe. Convenient pockets. Not in love with all the dangly bits and loops, but perhaps someone is using them. Since I get cold easily, I like that I can tuck my sweater through the cinchers for easy access without having to dig through my bag.
Very thin material, no pockets on the sides.
I love it. Very durable and spacious. You are able to carry many things.
does not really feel or look like it does in the picture, not a good every day bag.

Love this bag! More than enough room for the photo equipment I have (TrailPack A7, 3 lenses, tripod, misc accessories)! So many compartments for accessories, multiple access points for camera, multiple hanging spots for tripod. Fit great in overhead on recent trip to Kauai! Comfortable shoulder straps for longer hikes and nice padding on back.
This backpack is falling apart already I just received it in March! It’s a nice color but the quality is very poor. I’m disappointed.

It's a great looking backpack! I used it when I was traveling and it fit everything I needed it too and still had some room left over! Also a great price for what you're getting. I feel like a lot of people are bothered by the smell of plastic when things come in the mail. And this one smelled really strong of plastic so just let it air out for a couple days and that will eventually go away!
This backpack is a beautiful color and it holds up very well. It is a canvas backpack but it has a lot of storage room and you will be proud to wear it.
Not all synced. Not sure why. Kind of an expensive experiment if they don't all work. Still working in it
Love this backpack. I use it for school and store my laptop. I have used it whenever I go anywhere with my three kids, and I stuff it full. Comfy and do far has had nothing wrong with it.
very durable, i have about 35 pounds of textbooks every day with classes and it hasn't shown any signs of damage. The back is padded and comfortable. I'd highly recommend it to students
Few items like laptop, iPad and some tiny notebook can be accommodated. Not useful for anything else

Looks awesome and I use it a bunch, I specifically liked the wide open, but now it can be a pain to close if you don't have two hands. Also the wipe zipper is not like wipe pockets on other bags, it's really small.

The backpack is rather decent. I like the full-fleece lining laptop compartment. It's able to handle a 13" MacBook although it doesn't sit fully into the compartment. About an inch or so of the laptop will still be visible. Tried fitting a 15" MacBook, and it's just barely able to squeeze into the bag. The magnetic buttons still seem to work fine after months of usage. The leather straps however are starting to peel from the bottom edge.

I can’t comment on the durability or sturdiness. I’ve only been using this backpack for about a week. But I love it! I sure don’t have enough to fill all the pockets but. I use this for every day use. Somewhat as my purse. Plus also I can carry all my work papers.

Perfect for Disney World instead of a purse. The little pockets on the side are small and barely fit my water bottles..and Occasionally my bottle pops out. Lots of zippered compartments. Carried a package of ponchos for the family, 3 frozen water bottles, some snacks, 2 paperbacks, my meds, first aid kit and a couple fans that go around your neck. Lightweight. But not water proof - which is always handy. But overall a great deal.

The 17 inch is larger than I thought. Almost too large for work purposes to carry my iPad Pro and some other items. As a “personal item” for traveling I am here to tell you I filled it with a weekends worth of clothes etc and it fit just fine under the seat in front of me. Win!
My son loves this bag.
This backpack has so many pockets, it's awesome!! Very cute and not bulky.
Lau have this stuff is organize extra cords that you have

I give it an 8 out of 10 for durability it's not something you would want to throw tools in and take to a job site but it would be absolutely adequate for a student or cyclist, looks great, lightweight, good value for money

When I received my backpack it was sealed in plastic and put in a dust bag. I head something rattling inside the backpack when I began to open it and much to my shock, there were 2 vera bradley wallets (no tags so used), 2/3 bottle of hand sanitizer, and 2 used tubes of lip balms. The backpack appears to be in good shape but by virtue of the items inside the bag, it had been used.

I bought this to fit in my backpack for a trip to Europe. It fits perfectly. The finish scratches a bit, or I would have given it 5 stars. After 6 hours, the contents is cool, not cold, when you are out in the heat, but its what I needed. I would buy again.
It's a nice backpack. It just feels like plastic. My son is pretty rough on everything, so I don't see this lasting but for now it works and I love that it has a lot of pockets.
Weather resistant and light weight
Very nice bag for traveling. Perfect for the items needed close.

I get so many compliments on this bag. I love that the top has hard wire to keep it open to easily get to things with in it. The inside pockets and storage are great. The pocket on the back side fits an iphone easily.
Good quality, lot of pockets, sturdy material. Still waiting to see if it will stand upto toddler.
This bag is awesome! Great to use for a weekend getaway/ overnight - carry on bag for a flight. Wonderfully made!
Separate pocket for my kid's laptop. Small pockets inside for pens. The only small thing is it would be great if the pen pocket was zip or velcro so the pens didn't come out. Good quality.
I love this. So many pockets available!

I can communicate with it well, but I've had mine activated for 3 weeks and the battery is already at 40%. Also, it doesn't work with Alexa or Google Home. However, the price is great and it does work. Just keep an eye on that battery and use their app.
Easy to organize your items.
It’s canvas it’s doing to be destroyed by my kid. Luck life
